verdict.rationale: Secureframe has no documented export feature. The only route out is indirect: its API can reach any existing object in the account, and its official MCP server can read controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more. A user could script their own data extraction, but nothing documents bulk export, open file formats or an exit path. CSV appears only as an import route, not an export. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open-format outputs (CSV/JSON) for all data, offboarding or data-portability guidance, and independent corroboration that a complete export works.
